text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Step right up~! Fifty years of Umamusume~♪ 
A grand picture scroll of tears heard and 
tears told~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And so, I sprinted with all my might~ 
through my first three years in the 
Twinkle Series~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And even after that, you continued to 
fight on all alone...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Perseverance prevails! If you endure 
through hardship, good things will come—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Dantsu-dono, Miracle! So both of you 
are able to run again?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's been a long road since that 
Takarazuka Kinen, but somehow I made it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I thought just retiring like 
this would be an easy way out, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwahaha! No slacking off, now! Regardless, 
if you can make a comeback, all's well 
that ends well!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"To celebrate, I shall perform my 
'Horya-Horya Dance' for you!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, heave-ho! Ah, heave-ho! Here's to good 
fortune,チャンバララっと！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Jeez, No Reason-chan, what's with that~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason danced with joy. She couldn't 
contain her happiness.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't celebrate just because your 
return has been decided!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Onward, onward, into battle we go~~!! Show 
'em the power of your reborn selves~!

text_block_list.name: Dants & Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, each of them ran in their comeback 
race, but—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame in 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She took on the challenge with everything 
she had, but victory was out of reach!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Aah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle finishes the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) in 16th place.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She finished second to last, but 
considering it was her first race back 
from a break against this competition, it 
was somewhat inevitable."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: H-Huh~...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Grmmm~, what a pathetic display, you 
lot..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Long break or not, surely you could have 
done a bit better, no? Given your inherent 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I ended up tensing up too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Since it had been so long, my resolve was 
a bit squishy too. Well, don't sweat 
it..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what should we do about this, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
It's okay. Let's take our time and work 
through this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are no shortcuts. To run like I used 
to, I just have to gradually get my mind 
and body back into shape.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My, aren't you generous~. But what you say 
makes total sense!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Then Lady Dants, Mirako. Let us leisurely 
get ourselves back on track."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just taking it easy with me, while playing 
a game of shogi together!

text_block_list.name: Dants & Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them ended up 
occasionally playing shogi with No Reason, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lady Dantsu... Is she not here yet?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah!! Th-Then... with this hand...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Moving a Pawn like that will 
gain you nothing, nor cost you anything...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You thought about it for almost an hour... 
and that's what you came up with?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Because this seemed like the best 
option.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ A classic stalling tactic. Much like 
Musashi waiting for Kojiro to exhaust 
himself...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. I shall entertain you until 
the bitter end!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The match with Dantsu Flame took an 
unusually long time. And in the next 
match—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "It's my turn, right? Umm, well then..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: This "corner" goes... like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowah!? Nooooo, Mirako! How many times 
must I tell you before you understand?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bishops cannot move forward! Did I not 
explain how the pieces move?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, I'm sorry~. I just can't seem to 
remember it all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, maybe like this... Backing around 
the corner, backing up...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You can't fall back, eitheeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when playing shogi, my companions are 
remarkably unique and entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside her companions, No Reason would 
continue to enact tales full of dramatic 
twists and turns.
